title: "power"
format: html
---

```{r}
# remotes::install_github("scienceverse/scienceverse")
library(scienceverse)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(marginaleffects)
```

```{r}
study <- study("Power") |> 
  add_hypothesis(
    id = "H1",
    description = "The intervention will be superior to the control condition on a primary outcome"
    )
```

```{r}
study <- add_sim_data(
  study,
  data_id = "simulated_data_power",
  within = list(time = c("pre", "y")),
  between = list(group = c(int = "intervention", con = "control")),
  mu = data.frame(
    con = c(5, 5),
    int = c(5, 6),
    row.names = c("pre", "y")
    ),
  n = 100,
  sd = 3,
  r = 0.7
  ) 
```

```{r}
study <- add_analysis(
    study,
    id = "A1",
    software = R.version.string,
    code = {
    simulated_data_power$group <- relevel(simulated_data_power$group, 
                                          ref = "con")
    
    mod <- lm(y ~ group + pre, simulated_data_power)
    
    res <- hypotheses(mod, "groupint <= 0")
    
    tibble(
      estimate = res$estimate,
      lower_ci = res$conf.low,
      upper_ci = res$conf.high,
      p_value  = res$p.value
    )
  },
  description = "ANCOVA with post-intervention outcome (y) as the dependent variable, baseline measurement (pre) as a covariate, and group as a predictor. The posthoc comparison tests whether the, adjusted group difference is greater than zero."
  )
```

```{r}
study <- add_criterion(
  study,
  id = "C1",
  result = "p_value",
  operator = "<",
  comparator = 0.05,
  analysis_id = "A1",
  hypothesis_id = "H1"
  ) 
```


```{r}
study <- add_eval(
  study,
  "corroboration",
  evaluation = "C1",
  description = "The hypothesis is corroborated if the p-value from the one-sided test is smaller than 0.05"
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(8675309)
power <- study_power(study, rep = 1000)
```


```{r}
res <- get_power(power, values = TRUE)
str(res$power)
```


```{r}
study_save(study, "power.json", "json")
```
